top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Expectations for listed family home - Operate within the limits of its permit (26 TAC §745.8427(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the unannounced inspection, there were 6 unrelated children in care.      Three of the children left during the inspection correcting the deficiency.

top_violation_types.title: Parent right to enter and examine operation without advance notice (26 TAC §747.521(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Several children's records are missing parent rights information and liability insurance information.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1207(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The substitute caregiver has not received orientation training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information how parents to review a copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report was not observed in the operational policies.
